What is Creator Agency Partner (CAP)?

Creator Agency Partner (CAP) incubates and supports creators within the TikTok Shop ecosystem. These agencies either manage, represent, or have access to creator talents in the US and serve TikTok Shop by acquiring, educating, and incubating creators to produce Short Video + LIVE e-co content at scale.

What are the benefits of becoming a CAP on TikTok Shop？

Collaboration Opportunities

  • CAP can gain access to exciting collaboration opportunities with renowned sellers and brands. This opens doors to innovative and mutually beneficial partnerships.

Generous Financial Incentives

  • CAP are generously rewarded for their role in acquiring, educating, and incubating creators.

Professional Growth Guidance

  • CAP are offered custom guidance and comprehensive creator training programs by our partner ops team. These resources empower participants to achieve rapid growth and enhance their professional development.

CAP Partner services: Managed Support & Scaled Solutions

  • Managed support via an assigned one-to-one support to address agency partner needs and objectives by providing strategic value including but not limited to data analytics, strategic planning, and partner education
  • Scaled Solutions support designed to empower CAP agencies. This program aims to support agencies to be more self-sufficient, boosting their capabilities to incubate, empower and grow ecommerce creators.
